chapter: Teddy Wilson bands and Cafe Society
title: Teddy Wilson's band touring New England amusement parks
summary: After the Famous Door the band was based in Boston and played parks in New England; Hall's first road work.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Right, and then Charlie Barnet followed you?
And what happened? Then where did you go?
We went to New England, we were based in Boston and we opened up all of the amusement parks, up from Vermont, up to Maine, all New England.
Orchard Beach and all that kind of stuff?
Was this the first time you more or less been on the road? You know, otherwise, you had been more on location.
Yeah, I guess so. I had to think about that. I had always been more or less stationary.
Yeah. You really didn't make the whole band touring scene?
No., no. I had made some one-nighters out of town.
